# ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_network_service_config_cloud_vc (Resource)

Use the `ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_network_service_config_cloud_vc` resource to configure a Cloud ROUTER connection to a cloud virtual circuit network service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router" "example" {
  external_ref = "my-cloud-router"
}

data "ixapi_account" "customer" {
  external_ref = "my_account"
}

resource "ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_network_service_config_cloud_vc" "aws" {
  managing_account  = data.ixapi_account.customer.id
  billing_account   = data.ixapi_account.customer.id
  consuming_account = data.ixapi_account.customer.id
  cloud_router      = data.ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router.example.id
  network_service   = "500"
  address           = "192.0.2.1/30"
  bgp_neighbor      = "192.0.2.2"
  bgp_neighbor_asn  = 64512
  bgp_password      = "my-secret-password"
  admin_status      = "enabled"
  bfd_enabled       = true

  vlan_config {
    vlan_type = "dot1q"
    vlan      = 100
  }
}

output "config_id" {
  value = ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_network_service_config_cloud_vc.aws.id
}

output "config_state" {
  value = ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_network_service_config_cloud_vc.aws.state
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IP address for the BGP session (CIDR notation)
- `bgp_neighbor` (String) BGP neighbor IP address
- `bgp_neighbor_asn` (Number) BGP neighbor Autonomous System Number
- `billing_account` (String) Billing account ID
- `cloud_router` (String) Cloud ROUTER (VRF) ID
- `consuming_account` (String) Consuming account ID
- `managing_account` (String) Managing account ID
- `network_service` (String) Network service ID to connect to the Cloud ROUTER

### Optional

- `admin_status` (String) Administrative status (enabled/disabled)
- `bfd_enabled` (Boolean) Enable Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD)
- `bgp_password` (String, Sensitive) BGP session password
- `cloud_vlan` (Number) Cloud VLAN ID for cloud connections
- `external_ref` (String) External reference
- `handover` (Number) Handover ID
- `network_feature_configs` (List of String) Network feature configuration IDs
- `policy_egress` (String) Name of the outbound routing policy
- `policy_ingress` (String) Name of the inbound routing policy
- `purchase_order` (String) Purchase order reference
- `vlan_config` (Block List, Max: 1) VLAN configuration for the connection (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--vlan_config))

### Read-Only

- `connection_id` (String) Connection ID (read-only, if present in API response)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `policy_egress_id` (String)
- `policy_ingress_id` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `status` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedblock--vlan_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlan_config`

Required:

- `vlan_type` (String) The vlan_type determines if a additional configuration is required: For `port` no configuration is required, `qinq` and `dot1q` require the config specific fields to be set.

Optional:

- `inner_vlan` (Number) ID of the inner VLan. Only required with QinQ vlan type.
- `outer_vlan` (Number) ID of ther outer VLAN. If not present, the IXP will select a valid ID. Only required for vlan type QinQ.
- `outer_vlan_ethertype` (String) Outer vlan ether type, defaults to: 0x8100. Only used with type QinQ.
- `vlan` (Number) A VLAN tag. If not present, the IXP will auto-select a valid vlan-id. Only used with VLAN type Dot1Q.
- `vlan_ethertype` (String) VLAN ether type, defaults to: 0x8100. Only used with type Dot1Q.


<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `message` (String)
- `severity` (Number)
- `tag` (String)
- `timestamp` (String)
